title: RNA Extraction from Escherichia coli
author: Alice Pawlowski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kzycx7w

steps.title: Harvest and Resuspend Cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the cells and resuspend the pellet in NucleoZOL.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 5 min at 4°C and 14,000 x g.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml NucleoZOL (Macherey and Nagel).
Place on dry ice or store cells at -20 or -80 °C.

steps.title: Stop RNA Production
steps.instruction: Inhibit RNA production using stopmix solution.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1 ml of cells with 200 μl 'stopmix'-solution (5% phenol in ethanol) in a 2 ml tube.

steps.title: Lysis and Initial Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample and perform the first chloroform extraction.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 65 °C and 250 rpm (Thermomixer) for 10 min.
Mix with 400 μl Chloroform/Isoamylalcohol (Roti®-C/I) by inverting for 10 s.

steps.title: Purify Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Perform sequential centrifugation and extraction to isolate RNA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4°C for 10 min at 14,000 x g.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new reaction tube while working on ice.
Mix with 450 μl Phenol/Chloroform/Isoamylalcohol (Roti®-Aqua-P/C/I).
Centrifuge at 4°C for 10 min at 14,000 x g.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new reaction tube.
Add 1 volume of ice-cold Isopropanol and 20 μl 3 M Na-Acetate (pH 5.2), then mix.

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture to precipitate the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Leave the RNA at -20 °C for at least 30 min or store overnight.

steps.title: Recover RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge to pellet the RNA and perform the first wash.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4°C for 30 min at 14,000 x g.
Remove the supernatant, taking care of the RNA pellet.
Add 350 μl of ice-cold 75% ethanol.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Perform subsequent ethanol washes and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4°C for 5 min at 14,000 x g.
Add another 350 μl of ice-cold 75% ethanol.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 4°C and 14,000 x g.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Dry the final pellet and resuspend in water or buffer.

substeps.instruction: Remove the supernatant.
Dry the pellet at room temperature for approximately 15 min.
Resuspend the pellet in 30 μl molecular biology grade water or TE-buffer (10 mM Tris/HCL pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA).
